commands.name: memdb
commands.description: Search the memory database (/memdb <words>), or: stats, list, get <name>, sync
commands.output:
/memdb <words>        search memories, notes and indexed docs
/memdb stats          counts and database size
/memdb list           list memories and notes
/memdb get <name>     show an entry in full
/memdb sync           re-sync memory files now
Tools for Claude: memdb_search, memdb_add, memdb_get, memdb_index, memdb_forget

tools.name: memdb_search
tools.description: Ranked full-text search over the memory database: Claude memory files, saved notes and indexed docs. Use it before rereading a long notes file or when you need a fact you may have stored. Returns matching entries with snippets (set full to get whole bodies).

tools.name: memdb_add
tools.description: Save or replace a note in the memory database (names are unique: adding an existing name replaces it). Use it for niche facts that are too small or too many for the always-loaded memory file.

tools.name: memdb_get
tools.description: Show full entries by name (exact or substring match), up to 5.

tools.name: memdb_index
tools.description: Index markdown files (handoff notes, plans, long docs) into the database, split by heading, so memdb_search can find parts of them. Indexed files are re-synced automatically when they change.

tools.name: memdb_forget
tools.description: Delete a note that was saved with memdb_add. Memory files are removed by deleting the .md file instead.
